case_title: JEFFREY, CRAIG PRESTON VS FOOTHILL BANK C/O HOUTEN, DENISE VAN

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY JEFFREY, CRAIG PRESTON AS TO DEFENDANT FOOTHILL BANK C/O HOUTEN, DENISE VAN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-29-1993 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 03

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF JEFFREY, CRAIG PRESTON IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT FOOTHILL BANK C/O HOUTEN, DENISE VAN STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
